rappel_detail.anchor: boulder anchor with slings and a rap ring at the top of the block; inspect and back up
rappel_detail.station: The top of the West Peak summit block, which is recorded at 80-100 ft high.
rappel_detail.notes: The same rappel as the standard route, down the north side of the block on a 60 m rope used doubled. Then continue the traverse toward the Middle Peak.

set.rappels: 1 rappel off the West Peak summit block on a 60 m rope, as on the standard route; a short rappel off the Middle Peak's loose upper rock is sometimes needed depending on the moat
set.rappel_count_note: The one fixed rappel on the traverse is off the West Peak summit block. Some parties also make a short rappel, or downclimb carefully, off the Middle Peak's loose upper rock, depending on that season's moat; it is not listed because it is not always needed.
